changelog.title: Fixes for forms, captcha and the icon
new: A sharper "H" icon in the taskbar
Before submitting, the app now reminds you to type a captcha in Chrome, and waits for you
fixed: Gender (and other dropdowns) now use your saved answer even when the website pre-selects something else
Date of birth is now filled on websites with a calendar pop-up
Upload boxes whose only text is a size note, like "10 MB max size", are no longer asked about

changelog.title: Clearer look and better job search
new: New default look: Clean white, with a charcoal side panel. Themes are now Clean white, Sand, Emerald, Slate and Mint
Sharper, larger text and easier-to-read grey text
Quick actions, Activity and Report a problem now sit under one More item in the sidebar
Sharper "H" icon
Find jobs: "Where should I search?" is explained in plain words, and searching the web now always checks a built-in list of companies that hire marketers
Find jobs works from the job titles you type when no resume is found
fixed: Find jobs gave no answer when the resume was missing: it now says what to do
Search the web found nothing because search engines blocked it
Removed the duplicate "Paste a job link" bar from Home (use Apply), and the confusing dot and "1" in the sidebar

changelog.title: Safer LinkedIn, Indeed and Naukri
new: Paste LinkedIn, Indeed or Naukri links on Apply: the app keeps to a daily limit (default 10 per site) so your accounts stay safe
The app waits a little between jobs on these sites, like a person would
If a site asks you to prove you are human, the app waits for you and rests from that site if it keeps happening
Job links in LinkedIn, Indeed and Naukri alert emails now appear in Find jobs
New default look (Emerald: deep green with gold) plus new Peach and Mint themes; the other themes are still in Settings, Appearance
A gold "H" icon for the app window in the taskbar

changelog.title: Smarter forms and automatic updates
new: Updates install themselves from GitHub: checked at start, every hour, or with Check for updates
All new questions on a page come together on one card, with AI drafts per question
A small pop-up shows what was filled on each page
Profile knows many more ways sites ask the same thing: experience, notice period, current location, location preference, company, job title, education
New profile fields: gender, date of birth, current location, education, currently employed, key skills
Eight colour themes in Settings, Appearance
One job list on Apply: add links, apply to one, some or all; sent jobs leave the list
Find jobs keeps every found job on the page and explains why jobs were skipped
Install an update from a zip file if GitHub isn't set up
fixed: Windows launcher failed when the folder name had brackets
Removed the --no-sandbox warning bar in Chrome
Example text inside empty boxes was treated as a question
The privacy / terms tick box wasn't ticked
Captcha boxes are left for you instead of asked as a question
Phone country code didn't match '+91'
Clear message when Gmail needs an app password; automatic checks no longer pop up errors
Sidebar didn't reach the bottom of the window
Version 2.1 was listed twice in What's new

changelog.title: A fresh new look
new: Redesigned app with a sidebar, a job-hunt funnel on Home and calmer, clearer screens
My jobs is now a board: drag a card to change its stage, click it for emails and notes
New Settings page: appearance, job email, logins, job search, AI helper, help, updates and what's new
Quick actions: press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows) to jump anywhere or run a command
Pasted links turn into chips that show the job site, and you can save them for later in one click
Find jobs shows a match ring for every result, with select-all and one-click apply or save
Drop your resume onto Profile to add it
Questions can be answered with the number keys
A small celebration when an application is sent or an offer comes in
Press 1 to 6 to switch pages
fixed: Unsaved changes are now clearly shown, with Save and Discard buttons

changelog.title: Your own Career Hub
new: Renamed to Harshitha's Career Hub, with a personal greeting on Home
Everything personal now lives in one place: the “Harshitha's Data” folder with a single data file
Your old data is moved in automatically (and a copy of the old files is kept in Backups)
Dark mode: switch between Auto, Light and Dark with the button at the top
This “What's new” list, shown once after every update
Add resumes and cover letters from Profile → Files (no more copying files into folders)
“Open in Excel / Numbers” now makes a fresh copy of the list each time
fixed: Profile settings can no longer get out of order when you clear and refill a box

changelog.title: Email updates and a home screen
new: Reads your job Gmail and sorts replies into interview, assessment, offer, rejection or received
Home tab with your numbers and the emails that need your attention
My jobs tab: every application with its stage, latest email and your notes
Report a problem button: sends the log and screenshots to your helper
Install updates from inside the app, with automatic backups first, plus a daily backup
fixed: Closing the app no longer waits on a slow email check
Home cards no longer spill off the side of the window

changelog.title: Smarter and safer
new: Mac notification and sound when the app needs you
Copy and Logs buttons for the activity panel
Required boxes that are still empty are flagged before you submit
Old written answers that mention another company are shown for review, not pasted
Edit or delete remembered answers in Profile
Checks for the “thank you” message after submitting
Best-guess dropdown answers are highlighted in orange
Label on the job window so you can tell the two Chrome windows apart
Spots the same job opened through a different link
Better date fields (e.g. “Immediately”, “15/11/2026”)
Optional AI helper: drafts written answers and tailored cover letters
Second and third resumes, chosen automatically by job title
Daily automatic job search
Windows support
fixed: The AI button no longer appears on date and link fields
Submit confirmation now reads the application page, not the summary tab
